notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey all, just a clean-up update this time around.

- Fixed font issues with Arabic, Chinese and Korean sentences
- Improved display of sentences to match font display settings (e.g. Hiragana + Romaji vs Kanji + Hiragana)
- Fixed major bug with vehicle camera
- Various minor bug fixes

New features, new characters, new languages and game engine update coming soon(ish)!

-Ray

notes.title: World Life, Battle Improvements and Free Sentences
notes.content:
Hey all!
We have a pretty big update this time, most of this update's changes are based on feedback from players. 

- Added Day/Night cycle to improve world life
- Added talking NPCs with daily schedules to increase immersion
- Early sentence mini-games made free (more coming soon)
- In app purchases removed from the game (option to purchase will remain if a purchase has already been made, account codes will continue to be provided to our school users and Patreon supporters)
- Sentence categories added for review cards
- Some improved 3D models
- Improved window UI (should look smoother)
- Added some UI FX
- Decreased RAM usage by ~200MB, game now runs reliably with 3GB of RAM
- Robots patrol their area and chase the player a bit
- Robots are more varied in health and attack power
- Robot difficulty (number and strength) scales as you rescue more humans
- Dozens of new abilities/animations/FX added to robots (new abilities coming for Maco/humans in the next update)

The team is working on some exciting updates coming up in the next few months:
- Tasks and goals
- Experience system
- New modes of input for battles
- New vehicles to unlock
- 6 new languages
- Multiple playable characters (including a blast from the past)

Let us know if you have any questions or have some ideas for future improvements.

notes.title: Word cards and performance improvements
notes.content:
Hi all, this update introduces word cards.
The word list is now:

 Sorted into categories
 Searchable
 Visualised with images for each word
 Able to show where discovered objects are
 Able to show where undiscovered objects are (faded cards)


Other changes:

 Significantly improved frame-rate performance in Town/House level
 Added volume controls to settings
 Added 50 new vocabulary words
